title: Form Login and Logout
description: Customize the login page and add logout functionality.

slides.title: Login Form: The Default Page 📄
slides.content:
# Form Login vs HTTP Basic

HTTP Basic sends credentials in headers; Form Login presents an HTML page. You can enable form login with `.formLogin()`.

Spring Security provides a default login page, but you can customize it.

quizData.question: Which method enables the default form login page?
quizData.explanation: formLogin() enables form‑based authentication with Spring Security's default login page.

slides.title: Enabling Form Login
Custom Login Page (Optional) 🎨
Logout Handling
slides.content: With `.logout()`, Spring Security creates a `/logout` endpoint that invalidates the session and clears the security context. You can add a logout link in your pages: ```html Logout ``` After logout, the user is redirected to the URL specified in `logoutSuccessUrl()` (default is `/login?logout`).

slides.title: CSRF Protection
slides.content: Spring Security enables CSRF protection by default. If you use forms, include a CSRF token (automatically added by Thymeleaf). For REST APIs, you may disable it (`csrf().disable()`) if using stateless authentication.
